title: Web Development Essentials
shortDescription: HTML, CSS and JavaScript foundations for learners beginning a web development pathway.
description: Build and test accessible multi-page websites using semantic HTML, responsive CSS and client-side JavaScript. The course combines short demonstrations with practical exercises and a final website project.
learningOutcomes: Create semantic and accessible HTML page structures.
Apply responsive CSS layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop screens.
Use JavaScript to validate forms and update page content.
Test a small website and resolve common usability problems.

title: Business Analytics
shortDescription: Interpret business data and communicate findings through useful dashboards and reports.
description: Learn how to structure business questions, prepare data, interpret trends and present evidence for decision making. Practical activities focus on reporting quality and responsible interpretation.
learningOutcomes: Translate business problems into measurable analytical questions.
Interpret patterns, trends and exceptions in structured data.
Design clear dashboards for different stakeholder needs.
Present evidence-based recommendations and limitations.

title: UX/UI Design Studio
shortDescription: Plan user journeys, interfaces, wireframes and prototypes through a practical design process.
description: Explore user-centred design from initial research through interface prototyping and usability review. Learners create documented design decisions and a portfolio-ready interactive prototype.
learningOutcomes: Create user personas and task-focused journeys.
Produce low- and high-fidelity interface wireframes.
Apply hierarchy, consistency and accessibility principles.
Plan and evaluate a moderated usability test.

title: Project Management Practice
shortDescription: Use planning, scheduling, risk and teamwork techniques to control professional projects.
description: Develop a practical project plan, identify risks, assign responsibilities and monitor progress. Activities use realistic scenarios and require learners to justify delivery decisions.
learningOutcomes: Produce a scoped project plan with measurable milestones.
Evaluate delivery risks and select suitable responses.
Allocate work and communicate responsibilities clearly.
Monitor progress and recommend corrective action.

title: Online Learning Skills
shortDescription: Strengthen digital productivity, research, note-taking and independent study routines.
description: A focused starter course for learners returning to study or beginning online education. It covers digital organisation, source evaluation, planning and reflective learning habits.
learningOutcomes: Plan a realistic weekly online study schedule.
Organise notes and digital files consistently.
Evaluate the reliability of learning sources.
Use reflection to improve independent study habits.

title: Evening Professional Certificate
shortDescription: A part-time evening route combining professional communication, analysis and workplace planning.
description: Designed for working professionals, this longer certificate combines applied business communication, analytical thinking and project planning in supported evening classes.
learningOutcomes: Communicate concise professional recommendations.
Use structured analysis to evaluate workplace information.
Plan and monitor a small organisational improvement project.
Reflect on professional development goals and evidence.
